name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Place both hands inside your front foot.
Rotate your torso and reach one arm to the ceiling.
Return and straighten the front leg to stretch the hamstring.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A dynamic lunge-based stretch for the hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and shoulders.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Move gently; ease off with groin tightness.
